**Vitol** is a Swiss-based Dutch [multinational](Multinational_corporation "Multinational corporation") energy and [commodity trading](Commodity_trading "Commodity trading") company that was founded in <Rotterdam> in 1966 by Henk Viëtor and Jacques Detiger.[[1]](Vitol#cite_note-Businessnews-1)[[2]](Vitol#cite_note-reuters281011-2) Though trading, logistics and distribution are at the core of its business, these are complemented by refining, shipping, terminals, exploration and production, power generation, and retail businesses. Vitol is a privately held company by about 400 partners who are current and former employees,[[15]](Vitol#cite_note-15) who are known for their intense culture of privacy and secrecy from both competitors and the general public.[[16]](Vitol#cite_note-Fortune-16) It is reported that Vitol made a payout of $2.9 billion to all its partners in 2021.[[17]](Vitol#cite_note-17)[[18]](Vitol#cite_note-18)
